王野做着饭，王兰烧着火，剩下三个弟弟围着锅台眼巴巴的等着。随着锅里的香味传出，三个弟弟不约而同的咽着口水。

又炖了一会，王野觉得时间差不多了，拿来一个大盆，装出了半盆红烧肉。剩下的盖上锅盖留给爷爷奶奶他们下顿再吃。

王野端着盆，三个弟弟一步不离的跟着王野。把盆放在桌上，招呼爷爷奶奶太爷爷开始吃饭。三个弟弟拿着筷子就这么等着，要不说现在的孩子都很有规矩，家里大人不动筷子，就算是饿的不行也要等着。

太爷爷直接夹了一块儿放进嘴里，一脸陶醉的咀嚼着。三个臭小子见太爷爷吃了，争先恐后的开始夹肉。那样子生怕少吃一口。

只有王兰就啃着一个馒头。王野拿起她面前的碗，一口气给她夹了满满的一碗。放回他面前说：“吃，吃不完不许站起来。”

王野累了一天了也开始吃了起来，奶奶虽然有些心疼一顿就吃了这么多。但是也不会扫了大孙子的面子。众人吃的满嘴流油，王野也吃的心满意足。

吃完饭王野让爷爷给他开了一张买种子的证明，就回城了，奶奶好说歹说让王野带走了二十斤猪肉。奶奶还特意挑的最肥的一块儿。

王野推着车子前面走，王兰在后面跟着送他。王野喊道：“小兰，过来。”

王兰小跑两步赶紧跟王野并排，看向王野。看着这个妹妹王野叹了口气说：“小兰，你今年十五了是吧？”

王兰点点头没有说话，王野继续说：“我听说村里的姑娘十五六岁就找婆家了，别人家咱管不着，但是你不行，不到十八不能嫁人，这次回去大哥要出差几天，等大哥回来大哥给你找个工作，咱去城里。”

王兰吃惊的看着王野，这个妹妹真是让王野着急什么话也不敢说，王野继续说：“今天大哥说的话你记在心里，谁也别说。等大哥给你办好了我在告诉你爹娘。”

王兰虽然不懂但是大哥说的话必须要听的，含着眼泪点着头。到了村口王野说：“行了就送到这儿吧，别忘了大哥说的话。”王兰嗯了一声跟王野挥手告别。

王野骑着自行车一路风驰电掣，很快就到家了。一进门就被院子里的人吸引了注意，秦天熙和秦天韵倒是没什么，陈洛兮和陈少峰也来了。秦天韵和陈洛兮正在和小丫头王笑笑玩，秦天熙和陈少峰站在一边抽烟。

众人见王野进门，所有的眼神都看向了他。只有小丫头立刻飞奔入王野的怀里。嘴里还不停的叫着：“大锅，大锅。”

王野抱着小丫头打招呼道：“大哥，大姐你们怎么来了？”

秦天韵上前一步说：“这不是认认门吗，自己姑姑家都不知在哪儿还不让人笑话呀。”

王野继续问：“你们什么时候来的，吃饭了吗？”

秦天韵说：“来了一会儿了，正在等你呢，你舅舅叫你去家里吃饭。”

王野好奇的问：“怎么有事儿？”

秦天韵说：“我不知道，我就是跟着认门儿的。”

王野转头问秦天熙：“大哥你知道什么事儿吗？”

秦天熙说：“应该是关于你的问题，具体是什么我也不知道。”

王野想了一下也就没纠结，好事儿坏事儿还能怎样。王野说：“行吧，等我去跟我娘打声招呼。”

Wang Ye was cooking, Wang Lan was lighting the fire, and the remaining three brothers were waiting eagerly around the pot.As the aroma from the pot spread, the three brothers swallowed their saliva in unison.

After simmering for a while, Wang Ye felt that the time was almost up, so he brought a large pot and filled half of it with braised pork.Cover the rest with a lid and leave it to your grandparents for their next meal.

Wang Ye was holding the basin, and his three younger brothers followed Wang Ye step by step.Put the basin on the table and ask the grandparents to start eating.The three younger brothers held chopsticks and just waited. Otherwise, children nowadays are very well-behaved. The adults in the family would not move their chopsticks, even if they were very hungry, they would have to wait.

Grandpa directly took a piece and put it into his mouth, chewing it with a look of intoxication.When the three brats saw that their great-grandpa had eaten, they rushed to pick up the meat.That way I'm afraid I'll miss a bite.

Only Wang Lan was chewing a steamed bun.Wang Ye picked up the bowl in front of her and filled her with a full bowl in one go.Put it back in front of him and say, "Eat. Don't stand up until you finish eating."

Wang Ye started to eat after a tiring day. Although grandma felt a little distressed, she ate so much in one meal.But he won’t ruin his eldest grandson’s face.Everyone's mouths were full of oil, and Wang Ye was also satisfied with the food.

After dinner, Wang Ye asked his grandfather to give him a certificate for buying seeds, and then returned to the city. Grandma persuaded Wang Ye to take away twenty kilograms of pork.Grandma specially picked the fattest piece.

Wang Ye pushed the car forward, and Wang Lan followed behind to see him off.Wang Ye shouted: "Xiaolan, come here."

Wang Lan jogged two steps and quickly lined up with Wang Ye, looking towards Wang Ye.Looking at this younger sister, Wang Ye sighed and said, "Xiaolan, you are fifteen this year, right?"

Wang Lan nodded and said nothing. Wang Ye continued: "I heard that girls in the village find their husband's family when they are fifteen or sixteen years old. We can't control other people's families, but you can't. You can't marry before you are eighteen. My brother will be on a business trip for a few days this time. When he comes back, I will find you a job and we will go to the city."

Wang Lan looked at Wang Ye in surprise. This sister really made Wang Ye anxious and he didn't dare to say anything. Wang Ye continued: "Keep what big brother said today in your heart and don't say it to anyone. I will tell your parents when big brother has finished it for you."

Although Wang Lan didn't understand, she had to listen to what her elder brother said, and nodded with tears in her eyes.When they arrived at the entrance of the village, Wang Ye said, "Okay, just send it here. Don't forget what the elder brother said." Wang Lan hummed and waved goodbye to Wang Ye.

Wang Ye rode his bicycle at a fast pace and arrived home soon.As soon as he entered the door, he was attracted by the people in the yard. Qin Tianxi and Qin Tianyun were nothing, but Chen Luoxi and Chen Shaofeng were also here.Qin Tianyun and Chen Luoxi were playing with the little girl Wang Xiaoxiao, while Qin Tianxi and Chen Shaofeng stood aside smoking.

When everyone saw Wang Ye entering the door, all eyes turned to him.Only the little girl immediately ran into Wang Ye's arms.He kept shouting: "Big pot, big pot."

Wang Ye hugged the little girl and said hello: "Brother, sister, why are you here?"

Qin Tianyun took a step forward and said, "Isn't this a recognition of the family? I don't even know where my aunt's house is, so I don't want to make people laugh."

Wang Ye continued to ask: "When did you come? Have you eaten?"

Qin Tianyun said: "I've been here for a while. I'm waiting for you. Your uncle asked you to go home for dinner."

Wang Ye asked curiously: "Why is something wrong?"

Qin Tianyun said: "I don't know, I just followed the door."

Wang Ye turned to Qin Tianxi and asked, "Brother, do you know what's going on?"

Qin Tianxi said: "It should be about your question. I don't know what it is specifically."

Wang Ye thought about it for a moment and stopped worrying about what could be good or bad.Wang Ye said: "Okay, wait until I go say hello to my mother."
